Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class IdealGasPiggingModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.IdealGasPiggingModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class IdealGasPiggingModel extends Object implements Serializable
Conservative two-control-volume ideal-gas coupling for a single rigid pig.

The pig separates upstream and downstream gas inventories. Its pressure area is also the swept pipe area, so one signed displacement expands the upstream volume and contracts the downstream volume by the same amount. The existing PigMotion model resolves breakaway, stopping and reversal. The existing IdealGasReleaseModel supplies bidirectional short-orifice bypass, including the choked-flow transition. Beginning-of-substep pressures are used consistently for both gas boundary work and pig pressure work, making the combined gas/pig energy ledger conservative for every accepted substep.

This model is deliberately limited to a calorically perfect, single gas phase in two well-mixed control volumes. It does not represent pressure waves, distributed pipe friction, heat transfer, liquid sweeping, residual film, seal deformation, fittings or pig trains. The explicit substep and fractional-transfer controls are numerical safeguards, not fitted physical parameters.

  • Constructor Details

    • IdealGasPiggingModel

      public IdealGasPiggingModel(PigMotion mechanics, SystemInterface gasTemplate, double pipeLengthM, double launcherVolumeM3, double receiverVolumeM3, double bypassDiameterM, double bypassDischargeCoefficient, double inclinationRadians, double maximumSubstepSeconds, double maximumDonorMassFraction, double maximumPigTravelFraction)
      Creates a gas-side pigging model with explicit geometry and numerical safeguards.
      Parameters:
      mechanics - rigid-pig mechanical model; its pressure area is the swept pipe area
      gasTemplate - single-phase gas composition used by the ideal-gas bypass model
      pipeLengthM - launcher-to-receiver distance in m
      launcherVolumeM3 - positive dead volume behind a pig at the launcher in m3
      receiverVolumeM3 - positive dead volume ahead of a pig at the receiver in m3
      bypassDiameterM - circular bypass diameter in m; zero means a sealed pig
      bypassDischargeCoefficient - bypass discharge coefficient in (0, 1] when bypass is open
      inclinationRadians - constant pipe inclination in radians, positive uphill
      maximumSubstepSeconds - maximum accepted explicit coupling step in s
      maximumDonorMassFraction - maximum bypass transfer per substep as a fraction of donor mass, in (0, 0.5]
      maximumPigTravelFraction - maximum pig travel per substep as a fraction of pipe length, in (0, 0.25]
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for an invalid gas, geometry or numerical control
